existing_fixture_scope: Every legal match length/distance at eight bit offsets, fixed/dynamic trees, both padding values and multiple input/output fragment shapes; PNG/APNG, limits, malformed fields and literal/history suites are included in the full run.
performance_scope: Repeated photo comparison: reader +6.31% relative to Rust png (unchanged buffered decode -0.02%); streaming inflate +9.76% relative to flate2 (unchanged buffered inflate +1.46%). Format results are mixed and small; no independent format speedup is claimed. Shared-host variation remains and broad decoder parity is unproven.
